verdict.rationale: Manufact documents several programmatic surfaces. Its official MCP server exposes organizations, servers, deployments, logs and observability as tools so users can "manage everything" from an MCP client. API keys are documented for the REST API, CI and scripts, and the CLI manages servers, deployments and environment variables. However, there is no published REST API reference: every OpenAPI path probed returned 404. Nothing shows that UI-only features such as publish checklists and autofix, multi-client testing, billing spend limits, payload-capture toggles or production-branch settings are reachable via the API. missing for 10: documented REST API reference/OpenAPI spec, evidence of API coverage for publish checks, testing, billing and settings, independent confirmation of UI–API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
